en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ali Bin Ma’bad, from Al Husayn Bin Khalid, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘It was (inscribed) upon a ring of Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> – ‘خَزِيَ وَ شَقِيَ قَاتِلُ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ ( عليه السلام )’ “Disgraceful and wretched is the murderer of Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> Bin Ali<sup>asws</sup>”’.
en.sarwar: 6. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Afi ibn Ma’bad from af-Husayn ibn Khafid who has said the following: “Abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
On the ring of Ali ibn al-Husayn, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, the writing said, ‘Disgraced and destroyed are murderers of al-Husayn ibn Ah’ ‘Alayhi al-Salam.’”
